description: This file defines the `DefaultIndexKey` class, which implements the `IndexKey` interface. It represents a MongoDB index key consisting of a field name and an index direction, providing methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultIndexKey
classes.description: Immutable class representing a MongoDB index key with a field name and direction.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultIndexKey with the specified field name and default direction.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultIndexKey with the specified field name and direction.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the field name for this index key.

methods.name: getBsonValue
methods.description: Returns the BSON representation of the index direction.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks whether this DefaultIndexKey is equal to another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this index key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this index key.
